why: Rounds 1-4: text rewrites written by C3 never let a linear predictor beat per-action mean-delta. Round 5 uses real tool actions whose outcome is a deterministic, state-dependent tool result.

world.execution: each action is a real calc call through v13.agi.tools.ToolRegistry (IH-H29 policy, IH-H14 transaction) in a throwaway sandbox store; outcome text uses the returned tool result; every transaction record is bound as a row source
world.partitions: start values permuted with the same rng: train 50 %, calibration 15 %, retention 15 %, test 20 %; episodes whose normalized text occurs in another partition are dropped before taps are read

gates: unchanged original gates; all 4 taps x 2 arms x 3 seeds reported; no test-based selection
limits: arithmetic on a one-line counter is a minimal world; outcomes are exact tool results, the model only encodes them
